page.layout: One printed page, one text column in the centre with a marginal note at the right margin ("* Martia:" beside the first lines, plus a handwritten mark which is not printed). Running head at top; page number at top right. Left margin holds only show-through and stains.

main_text.l: quasi Thier, bruta pecus. Qui autem
plus solito tacet, in bis dumps, dicitur.
det, sono pariter & sensu, Saxon. dom,
bus Spelmannus nofter in voce Domi-
nicum; nisi malis à domus, quod tem-
plum domus sit per excellentiam, Dei
scil. ipsius domus. Hîc etiam vide Ki-
lian. verbo Dom. & Befold. de Nat.

page.notes: Marginal handwriting and show-through omitted. Several Gothic words in the text are set in black letter and rendered approximately; the bottom signature "Ff 2" is a gathering mark and is therefore left out of the main text. Doubtful readings: "Egisliikis" (last word of page), "zeodpylo".
